items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I went over once with Anna Marie Alberghetti and we did this show with Bob Hope overseas

ctx.x: was I asked Bob Hope if he believe in integra-tion. And his answer was to be yes. I say his answer was to be that. If he said no, I wouldn't be able to do the gag. So when he said yes, I did the gag on our first show that we did overseas following him not doing the dance that we had rehearsed together during a return for a bow on the stage he didn't do the dance, he just went down front and said, "There he is, John Bubbles. We've been trying for six weeks or six months to get John Bubbles and we finally got him."…

But I'm mad now because he don't do his dance that we rehearsed together. So I said, "Hey, Bob, do you believe in integration?" With all these soldiers integrated he's got to say yes. So he says, "Yes." So I says, "Well, kiss me." And that did it. That did it. You can imagine that, can't you? So that was my first gag with him. Well, coming back, he was ever so glad. I went over once with Anna Marie
Alberghetti and we did this show with Bob Hope overseas, which was very good --
